max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the generation. Omit to retain the provider default. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

enable_image_search.description: Ground image generation with Google Image Search. Can be combined with enable_web_search; source attribution is returned in grounding_metadata. Uses direct Google or Vertex APIs.

resolution.description: The resolution of the image to generate.

history.description: Previous native Gemini turns, including original parts and thought signatures from conversations. The current prompt starts a new user turn.

seed.description: The seed for the random number generator.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image. Supports extreme ratios: 4:1, 1:4, 8:1, 1:8.

context.description: Ordered text, image, PDF, UTF-8 text-file or video parts appended to the current prompt. Original media bytes are preserved; images count toward the total 14-reference limit.

enable_web_search.description: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.

audio_url.description: Optional audio file to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB).

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Omit to use the provider default of 1. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

include_thoughts.description: Whether to include thought summaries. Omit to preserve the existing behavior: an explicit thinking_level requests summaries. Set limit_generations=false to return summary text in description. This doe

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability. Omit to use the provider default of 0.95. Explicit values use a direct Google or Vertex API.

image_urls.description: The URLs of the images to use for image-to-image generation or image editing. Optional when at least one of `video_url`, `audio_url`, or `pdf_url` is provided.

system_prompt.description: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system mess

return_history.description: Return reusable native conversations with original image parts and provider thought signatures. Uses a native provider. Each generated conversation is independent; send its messages as history for the

safety_tolerance.description: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

limit_generations.description: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate and

thinking_level.description: Controls thinking effort ('minimal' or 'high') and requests thought summaries. Omit to use the provider default ('minimal'); thinking cannot be disabled.

pdf_url.description: Optional PDF document to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB).

video_url.description: Optional video to use as input context. Accepts an http(s)/data URL to a video file (downloaded and sent inline, max 15MB) or a YouTube URL (passed through to the model without downloading).

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
